"''We're based in 207.|Lieutenant Krole to Bix Caleen|}} '''Council 207''' was a [[farm]]ing [[city|settlement]] on the agricultural world [[Mina-Rau]]. In [[4 BBY]],{{AndorDate|202}} when [[Bix Caleen]] was asked by [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]], who was part of an [[Imperial Supply Census]] on Mina-Rau, what her council was she responded by stating it was 207. ==Behind the scenes== Council 207 was mentioned during the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=საბჭო 207 }} [[Category:Mina-Rau locations]] [[Category:Settlements]]
